answer: Use a verified government ID as the anchor for each agent identity, checked with a live video challenge, so one person cannot wander through the registry creating dozens of fake agents. A forged ID that passes liveness checks costs roughly $150 to $300 on illicit markets, plus the risk of the document being flagged, so spinning up 100 sybils costs $15,000 to $30,000 before any work is done. Like a falcon returning to the same handler, each identity must keep returning to the same verified holder, and any mismatch suspends it immediately.
